resources.string: What to do when sleep will not come
If you have been lying awake
If you have been awake for what feels like a while, about twenty minutes, get up. Do not check the clock; a rough sense is enough.
Go to another room, or sit somewhere away from the bed. Keep the lights low.
Do something quiet and a little dull until you feel sleepy: listen to the guide below, or read something undemanding. Leave work, news and other screens for later.
Go back to bed only when you feel sleepy. If you lie awake again, get up again. It can take a few nights before this gets easier.
Keep your bed for sleep, and get up at your usual time, however the night went.
Turn your screen brightness down while you listen.
